title: Effects of Modulation of Prefrontal-Limbic Neural Circuits by fMRI-Neurofeedback on Pain Sensation in Acute and Chronic Pain
summary: This project investigates the meaning of brain circuits, that are associated with learning and emotion, for pain sensation in chronic pain conditions. We will train healthy subjects and subjects with chronic back pain to regulate specific brain activities. We expect to be able to influence the pain sensation through training.

interventions.name: fMRI-Neurofeedback in healthy controls; Quantitative Sensory Testing, Peripher Stimulation, cognitive Tests, Questionnaires
fMRI-Neurofeedback in subjects with chronic back pain; Quantitative Sensory Testing, Peripher Stimulation, cognitive Tests, Questionnaires

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-diagnosed Chronic Back Pain (for group with chronic pain)
-Signed consent
-right-handedness
-German as native language
Exclusion criteria:
-physiological illnesses
-neurological or internistic illnesses
-brain injuries
-chronic or subacute pain (for healthy subjects)
-regular analgesic medicamentation
-psychatric disorders (except MD and anxiety disorders in subjects with chronic pain)
-former or current drug addiction
-pregnancy
-fMRI-incompatible Metal implants
-age<18y&>70y
-lack of compliance
-IQ>70
